sources.title: Samoan Epidemic Commission (Report of), 1919, H-31 c
sources.publisher: New Zealand Parliamentary Papers / National Library of New Zealand, Papers Past
sources.evidenceNote: Inspected browser Text-tab OCR, report pp 3–6 and 9–11: 7 November 1918 arrival in Samoan time (8 November NZ); 4 November refers to Suva; quarantine failures and administrative confusion; commissioners’ criticism of not seeking Pago Pago aid and 28 November wireless closure. Report pp 3–4 distinguish 7,542 deaths to 31 December from an 8,500 later estimate. OCR was not exhaustively checked against page images; colonial descriptions and judgments remain attributed to the commissioners. This review corroborates selected claims, not all existing narrative or later mortality estimates.

reviewLimit.en: The institutional history and selected passages of the 1919 commission report support the arrival date and administrative failures. The primary report was inspected as OCR (pp 3–6, 9–11), not as an exhaustively checked facsimile. Its colonial framing and mortality estimates require attribution; the later approximate population-loss estimate remains separately sourced.
reviewLimit.zh: 机构历史与1919年调查报告的所选段落支持到达日期及行政失误。原始报告以OCR文字形式阅读（第3—6、9—11页），未逐字核对完整影印本。其殖民叙述及死亡估计须保留归属；后来的人口损失近似估计仍另有所据。

note.en: V11 source-only follow-up: selected primary-report OCR is now inspected. The original V10 narrative, date and location are retained; the earlier access limit remains in the evidence-review history.
note.zh: V11仅补充来源的复查：现已阅读原始报告所选OCR文字。保留V10原有叙述、年代与位置；早先的访问局限保存在证据复查历史中。
